text:
zoe.infosec: FYI discovered tokens in a middleware debug dump produced by the new ConnectorX integration. Quick containment checklist below.

henry.infra: how severe? which tokens?

zoe.infosec: Found 4 long-lived service keys and 3 CI tokens. Files stored in `s3://redwood-debug/connectorx/dumps/2026-04-02/*`. Pattern: `kx_svc_[A-Za-z0-9]{28}`. No external exfil observed so far.

mike.platform: owners? we need names to start rotations.

zoe.infosec: owners: stream-processor (2 long), billing-sync (1 long), frontend-build (3 ephem). Sending DMs now.

security-bot: [alert] ConnectorX v1.4.0 produced debug dump containing potential secrets. Ticket SEC-2026-255 opened.

tara-legal: legal on standby. Please collect timeline and vendor contact info before any external comms.

henry.infra: immediate actions I recommend:
- disable debug dumps for ConnectorX in prod and staging
- rotate long-lived keys now
- redact and quarantine debug dumps in S3 (retain audit copy restricted to sec+legal)
- run artifact search for `kx_svc_` across archives

ana-sre: typo - nina-sre: I'll add an ingestion filter to redact `kx_svc_` patterns at write-time. PR ready.

zoe.infosec: agreed. Priorities: rotate stream-processor, billing-sync. Frontend-build ephemeral tokens can be rotated as CI jobs run.

henry.infra: I ran `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-debug/connectorx/dumps/2026-04-02/` and pulled 6 files; 7 matches total across the dump set. Starting rotation for stream-processor keys (in progress).

mike.platform: disabling debug dumps via flag: `configctl set connectorx.debug false --env prod,staging` (done). Dev remains on for triage.

zoe.infosec: please use `sensitive-redact` to replace tokens in dumps and move originals to `s3://redwood-archives/quarantine/SEC-2026-255/`. Keep access locked.

security-bot: [info] redact job queued: job-id rdw-redact-255.

henry.infra: rotations complete for stream-processor. Billing-sync rotation started, will coordinate canary to avoid billing outages.

ana-sre: PR for redact middleware: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/PR-511  matches `kx_svc_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}` and exports metric `ingest.redact.connectorx.hits`.

mike.platform: can we whitelist a 20m debug window for dev to re-enable dumps to verify scrub? Need approval.

zoe.infosec: approve 20m for dev only. Prod remains disabled until vendor confirms fix or our middleware is in prod.

tara-legal: vendor contact requested. Who's reaching out?

mike.platform: I'll contact ConnectorX support and escalate to their security team. Sending email now.

henry.infra: scanning archives for `kx_svc_` across buckets now. Posting results here in 30m.

zoe.infosec: note for owners: update SEC-2026-255 with rotation commands + evidence (logs, commit hashes).

henry.infra: archive scan found 3 additional matches in older debug bundles (2019-2023). Adding to quarantine and scheduling nightly scan for 7 days.

mike.platform: ConnectorX responded: they accepted the report and said they'll patch their debug dumper within 72h. Asked for sample logs to triage. Legal wants mínimo PII.

tara-legal: provide vendor with only what's necessary for triage. Save full copies in quarantine.

ana-sre: redact middleware merged to staging. Will run smoke tests and then prod deploy after signs are green.

zoe.infosec: remaining actions checklist:
- vendor fix confirmation or our middleware in prod (security)
- complete rotations and post evidence (owners)
- nightly archive scan for 7 days (infra)
- post-incident writeup (zoe)

mike.platform: I'll draft an internal ops note for affected teams and ping support channels.

henry.infra: rotation for billing-sync complete, canaries healthy. No customer-facing impact detected.

zoe.infosec: thanks. Please add final status here when done so we can close SEC-2026-255. We'll reconvene in 24h for closure review. :lock:
